content: I now understand the complete modularization plan: Official base template (581 lines, full LLM) needs continuity integration from dbops template. The ContinuityBackend class manages DragonflyDB, MongoDB, Neo4j, and NATS. I need to integrate this into the official base for Week 1, then modularize for Weeks 2-3. Collaboration with Tesseract using ToolOps framework.
